paragraphs.text: Alirios is a human without a class from Theros .

Alirios debut as a character in Theros Beyond Death as an adult male human with brown hair wearing blue shirt and shirts each with gold accents. He is a narcissist known for staring longingly at his reflection in a pond, which is represented by him entering the battlefield tapped and staying tapped while the player controls a Reflection . Alirios has somehow been able to magically empower his reflection to battle for himself with a Reflection token being created when he first enters.
